source.kc_tr: [AS] the basal transpiration coefficient of the weed canopy at full cover: the FAO-56 Kcb of a closed green grass or broadleaf stand is about 1.0 (Allen et al. 1998, table 17, mid-season values 0.9-1.15; recalled). Volunteer wheat takes the 1.1 of the wheat crop file.
source.p_depletion: [AS] 0.5: share of the root-zone TAW that can be used before the group is water stressed, the FAO-56 default for crops of about this rooting (table 22 lists 0.45-0.6 for cereals and grasses; recalled).
source.cover_per_g_m2: [AS] canopy cover = 1 - exp(-k x biomass): leaf area about 0.015 m2 per g of dry matter (specific leaf area ~25 m2/kg, 60 % leaf) times an extinction coefficient 0.5 gives k = 0.0075 m2/g, i.e. 100 g/m2 of weeds cover 53 % of the soil.

source: F1c weed group: volunteer winter wheat from shed grain. Every number is [AS].
